confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium-confidence. They rest on a few mixed-date web sources (a 2026 restaurant listing of about 120 THB for a large beer, roughly 73 to 94 THB for beer and 72 to 77 THB for cappuccino in other listings, and Bangkok/Thailand bar and restaurant ranges), converted at an assumed rate of about 32 to 33 THB per USD. The cocktail anchor is low-confidence: no specific Koh Samui cocktail price was found, so it is estimated from the local beer-to-cocktail price relationship. The wine anchor is also low-confidence, based on imported-wine markups in Thai sources. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Koh Samui's guesthouse and hotel market. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected, so they are low-confidence and may be well off for specific seasons or areas.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Thai resort islands and mainland Thai tourist cities, such as Phuket and Bangkok, with Koh Samui-specific adjustments for its higher island markups on imported drinks and tourist-area dining. Accommodation is benchmarked to general Gulf of Thailand island guesthouse and mid-range hotel tiers.
